entries.f05aa5b8412dbed9: This business provides a range of logistics services to customers, including warehousing and cargo handling, port operations and transport, overseas logistics services and multimodal transport, air freight transport, 3PL (contract logistics), supply chain management support and land cargo transport. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥291,963 million, accounting for most of the consolidated operating revenue of ¥299,472 million. The main operators are subsidiaries such as Mitsui-Soko, Mitsui-Soko Logistics, Mitsui-Soko Express, Mitsui-Soko Supply Chain Solutions and Mitsui-Soko Transport, all of which are classified under the Logistics Business in the status of affiliated companies. The company also has subsidiaries overseas, including in the United States, China, Singapore, Thailand, Malaysia and the Czech Republic.
